candidate_catalog.entry: accepted M15 Bid open after failure
candidate_catalog.exit: accepted M15 Bid open 8 bars later

candidate_catalog.entry: first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidate_catalog.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= entry_boundary_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

candidate_catalog.confirmation: the first completed raw-tick-derived M1 bar after failure_bar_end must close on the failure side of the shock midpoint and have a body in the entry direction
candidate_catalog.entry: first raw tick after that M1 bar completes; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidate_catalog.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= original failure_bar_end_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask
first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end_plus_60_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

chronology_rule: failure is known only after the following M15 bar closes; entry is the first executable tick at or after that close

definition.csos_entry: open of the first M15 bar after the failure bar
definition.csos_exit: open exactly 8 completed M15 bars after CSOS entry
definition.down_shock: shock AND close < open AND close_position_in_range <= 0.20
definition.failure_down: the immediately following completed M15 bar closes above the shock midpoint and closes above its own open
definition.failure_up: the immediately following completed M15 bar closes below the shock midpoint and closes below its own open
definition.same_variant_reentry: not allowed until prior 8-bar holding interval has ended
definition.up_shock: shock AND close > open AND close_position_in_range >= 0.80

same_shock_reentry: prohibited by original CSOS active-window suppression
session_boundary: events may cross sessions; session is classified at entry
spread_and_execution: Mid is never used as an executable price; LONG buys Ask/sells Bid, SHORT sells Bid/buys Ask
